think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal operating range. 2) Check the official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/enable/auto/inherit) rather than acting as an ordered numeric magnitude. 3) Determine whether such a value makes the knob perform a qualitatively different function (e.g., disabling a feature) versus simply being an extreme point on the same scale. 4) If a sentinel value exists and changes semantics, classify as a special knob and record that value; otherwise classify as not special.
